about: Hand-written synthetic extraction set (P1-D, 2026-10-22). Each unit is what the engine receives as one document: a conversation transcript in the 'User:/Assistant:' format chat.ts saves, or a first-person note. `expected` = facts a careful human would store (any wording; `speaker` = who asserted it). `forbidden` = things that must NOT be stored as the user's facts. Dates in expected facts are resolved against `documentDate`. Not yet spot-checked by the owner.
